```{python}
#| include: false
# Plotly figures as bare divs: plotly.js comes once from _deck/header.html, and no CDN MathJax tag.
import plotly.io as pio
from plotly.io.base_renderers import MimetypeRenderer

class DeckRenderer(MimetypeRenderer):
    def to_mimebundle(self, fig_dict):
        html = pio.to_html(fig_dict, full_html=False, include_plotlyjs=False,
                           include_mathjax=False, config={"responsive": True})
        return {"text/html": html}

pio.renderers["deck"] = DeckRenderer()
pio.renderers.default = "deck"
```
